title: Ezekiel Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on Ezekiel 10: coals of fire scattered over the city, the wheels like beryl and the glory over the cherubim.

questions.text: What appeared in the expanse over the head of the cherubim?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:1 says there appeared above them as it were a sapphire stone, as the appearance of the likeness of a throne.

answers.text: Something like a rainbow set in a cloud
A scroll of a book written within and without
Something like a sea of clear crystal
Something like a sapphire stone, like a throne

questions.text: What was the man clothed in linen told to do between the whirling wheels?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:2 tells him to go in under the cherub and fill both his hands with coals of fire from between the cherubim, and scatter them over the city.

answers.text: Set a mark on the foreheads of the men who sigh
Measure the inner court of the house of Yahweh
Fill his hands with coals of fire and scatter them over the city
Carry out the scroll of the book from the house

questions.text: Where did the cherubim stand when the man went in, and what filled the inner court?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:3 says the cherubim stood on the right side of the house when the man went in, and the cloud filled the inner court.

answers.text: On the left side of the house, and fire filled the court
On the right side of the house, and the cloud filled the court
At the east gate, and smoke filled the court
In the outer court, and darkness filled it

questions.text: Where did Yahweh's glory stand when it mounted up from the cherub?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:4 says Yahweh's glory mounted up from the cherub and stood over the threshold of the house, and the house was filled with the cloud.

answers.text: Over the threshold of the house
Over the east gate
Over the bronze altar
Over the mountain outside the city

questions.text: How far was the sound of the wings of the cherubim heard, and what was it like?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:5 says the sound of their wings was heard even to the outer court, as the voice of God Almighty when he speaks.

answers.text: Only within the inner court, like a whisper
To the outer court, like the blast of a trumpet
To the outer court, like the voice of God Almighty
Throughout the city, like the roar of chariots

questions.text: Who put the fire into the hands of the man clothed in linen?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:7 says the cherub stretched out his hand from between the cherubim to the fire, took some of it and put it into the hands of the man clothed in linen.

answers.text: The man took it himself from the altar
The cherub, reaching out from between the cherubim
One of the six men with slaughter weapons
The wheels poured it out on him

questions.text: How many wheels were beside the cherubim, and what did they look like?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:9 says there were four wheels beside the cherubim, one wheel beside each cherub, and their appearance was like a beryl stone.

answers.text: Four wheels, one beside each cherub, like a beryl stone
One wheel only, like an awesome crystal
Four wheels, like burning coals of fire
Two wheels, like burnished bronze shields

questions.text: According to verse 12, what was full of eyes all around?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:12 says their whole body, including their backs, their hands, their wings, and the wheels, were full of eyes all around.

answers.text: Only the rims of the four wheels, all around
Only their four faces and nothing besides
Their wings alone, and not their bodies
Their whole body, their backs, hands, wings and the wheels

questions.text: What were the four faces of each one, according to verse 14?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:14 says the first face was the face of the cherub, the second the face of a man, the third the face of a lion, and the fourth the face of an eagle.

answers.text: A cherub, a man, an ox and an eagle
The cherub, a man, a lion and an eagle
A man, a lion, an ox and an eagle
A man, a lion, an eagle and a calf

questions.text: Where did the cherubim stand after they mounted up from the earth?
questions.explanation: Ezekiel 10:19 says they lifted up their wings, mounted up from the earth and stood at the door of the east gate of Yahweh's house, with the glory of the God of Israel over them.

answers.text: At the threshold of the house
In the plain by the river Chebar
At the door of the east gate of Yahweh's house
At the north gate of the inner court
